GST Council Meeting to Discuss Process Reforms and Compliance

The 57th Goods and Services Tax (GST) Council meeting is scheduled to discuss significant process reforms aimed at simplifying compliance and expediting refunds for businesses. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has indicated that the next phase of GST reforms will focus on making compliance easier. The agenda includes potential changes to input tax credits and an overview of current compliance measures. These discussions are anticipated to impact Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Indian corporations.
